SIGI.basis: after-tax core income (issuer non-GAAP operating income)
SIGI.note: Core-income-based IOMA: issuer non-GAAP operating income is AFTER TAX and attributable to common shareholders, not industrial pretax operating income. It excludes realized/unrealized investment gains after tax; use identical definitions across years. Total revenue retains those investment movements, so a separately normalized revenue view is essential.

UVE.note: Screen uses verified total GAAP revenue and company adjusted operating income consistently in both IOMA and current margin. Thus calculated margin differs from the company’s published adjusted margin, which uses core revenue. Separate core-revenue view: 444.310/400.030; adjusted margin 17.4%/13.4%; core-denominator IOMA 53.7%. Do not silently replace screening revenue.

VTMX.note: Use consolidated adjusted EBITDA, not property-level NOI. Release precision is USD 0.1m, not the screen’s extra decimals. Revised definition excludes energy income and expense in both reported comparative periods. Screen margin uses total revenue 79.6, not company ex-energy revenue 77.5; company published margin 84.1% therefore differs. Ex-energy IOMA also fails the threshold. Revaluation gains do not enter this EBITDA numerator.

BHRB.note: Pretax-income-based fallback; net interest income plus noninterest income is issuer total revenue: 105.016+14.722=119.738 versus 73.770+11.585=85.355. Original screen 169.45 is gross interest income plus fees (154.724+14.722), not net bank revenue. Do not mix gross and net denominators or replace consolidated profit with pre-provision earnings.

Current contract assets858.646 and receivables634.743 require collection validation. The Oracle customer-consideration asset306.5 is share-based, not cash capex; its future revenue amortization is an additional economic burden.

The stock-based customer consideration generated a0.5 current-quarter revenue adjustment; it is too small to explain the main revenue jump but future amortization and customer concentration remain relevant.
BE.outlook: Q4 2026: raised FY revenue4.4–4.6bn and adjusted operating profit960–1,030m support continued growth and better profit, with medium confidence; cash recovery remains low confidence pending milestone collections and capex. FY2027 (Jan1–Dec31): partly durable revenue/profit thesis, medium-low confidence because installation, capacity and customer funding timing can reverse conversion; normalized cash outlook insufficient evidence. Neither horizon earns85–95% confidence.
BE.watch: Falsifiers: receivables/contract assets continue to outgrow sales; deposit inflows reverse; capex ramp persists without collections. Base case demand remains strong; adverse case customer acceptance delays and added capacity costs compress margin despite recognized sales.

WDC.outlook: Q2 FY2027 (quarter ending around Jan1,2027): guided revenue5.0–5.2bn, adjusted gross margin60–61%, opex400–410m. Midpoint implied adjusted operating profit=5,100×60.5%−405=2,680.5m (analyst calculation, no unsupported EPS conversion). Revenue/profit near-term likely durable, medium-high confidence; cash partly durable, medium. Next fiscal year FY2028 (Jul3,2027–Jun30,2028): medium-low confidence, highly sensitive to hyperscaler demand, technology transitions and pricing. No85–95% durable-IOMA claim.
WDC.watch: Base case order and pricing strength supports margins. Adverse case high-capacity supply expansion, pricing competition or customer digestion lowers conversion; monitor exabytes, price/TB, gross margin and gross capex. Adverse case claims inflation/reopened casualty reserves overwhelms pricing, or premium contraction shrinks invested float. Monitor reserve development by accident year, retention, earned premium, catastrophe losses and claims cash payments.
